title: Entering the Truffle Regio
heading: The Realm of the Truffles
summary: How characters find and enter the truffle regio: it needs a guide or exact location, one character able to see the regio, and a local Magic aura that only exists on the solstices and equinoxes. Leaving is possible at any time.
quotes: The Magic aura outside of the regio is 1, only on the solstices and equinoxes, which means that the players must roll against an Ease Factor of 9 to see inside.
related: ArM5 p.189 entering and leaving regiones
ArM5 p.158 Piercing the Magical Veil

title: Truffle Regio, first level (Regio Entrance)
heading: Regio Entrance
summary: Describes the outermost level of the regio, its Magic aura, how to spot the path leading onward, and how the Wild Boar of the Woods intercepts intruders and sends them after interloping wolves.
quotes: The first level of the regio has a Magic aura of 3.
With a Hunt + Perception roll against an Ease Factor of 9, the character notices a path leading away from the regio entrance.
related: Realms of Power: Magic p.55 Creatures of Virtue

title: Truffle Regio, second level (Truffle Fields)
heading: Truffle Fields
summary: Describes how to reach the second level of the regio, which has a stronger Magic aura, and what happens if the characters cannot see the way on and loop back to the first level.
quotes: The second level of the regio has a Magic aura of 5.
related: ArM5 p.158 Piercing the Magical Veil

title: Truffle Regio, third level (Truffle Holt)
heading: Truffle Holt
summary: Describes how characters cross into the third and final level of the regio, which has the strongest Magic aura, with help from the truffle workers or by finding the entrance themselves.
quotes: The third and final level of the regio has a Magic aura of 7.

title: Tests of the Truffle Matron
heading: Tests of the Truffle Matron
summary: The Matron's trials before she makes requests: a scuffling duel, a tug-of-war resolved by opposed Simple Die rolls with Size bonuses, a plant-healing challenge, and a tribute procession, which together set the size of the vis reward.
quotes: For every Size point the awakened tree is larger than the character, add +2 to the tree's die roll.
If the difference is less than 5, the two roll again and continue to roll until the accumulated difference between their rolls is 5 or more.
related: ArM5 p.174 scuffling
ArM5 p.135 The Bountiful Feast

title: Creo-aligned aura of the Truffle Regio
heading: Aura
summary: Explains the effects of a Creo-aligned Magic aura: doubled aura bonus for Creo activities, aura added to Recovery rolls, cheaper Might for Creo creatures, instant healing of minor hurts, slowed apparent aging and a Living Conditions bonus for a full year.
quotes: The Magic aura bonus is doubled in the regio for all activities involving Creo.
For each season the character spends in the aura, his apparent age is decreased by one, but does not decrease below 27.
related: Realms of Power: Magic p.16 aligned auras

title: Enriching a Beech Tree of Virtue
heading: Beech Tree of Virtue
requires: Setting: Trees of Virtue in the Truffle Regio (Mythic Locations)
summary: Procedure for Enriching branches from a Beech Tree of Virtue into an amulet that temporarily grants the Luck Virtue, and the vis obtained from its beechnuts.
quotes: While the amulet is worn, the character is treated as having the Luck Virtue (**ArM5**, page 45).
related: Realms of Power: Magic Trees of Virtue

title: Enriching a Poplar Tree of Virtue
heading: Poplar Tree of Virtue
requires: Setting: Trees of Virtue in the Truffle Regio (Mythic Locations)
summary: Procedure for Enriching leaves and twigs from a Poplar Tree of Virtue into a crown that briefly grants the Long-Winded Virtue to one wearer, plus the vis from perfect leaves.
quotes: The Enriched crown only grants the Long-Winded Virtue to one person
related: Realms of Power: Magic Trees of Virtue

title: Truffles of Virtue
heading: Truffles of Virtue
summary: Explains how Truffles of Virtue are Enriched by being eaten by a Magic creature and propagated by fertilizing trees, and how they count as Dedicated vis if used another way.
quotes: Truffles of Virtue may be Enriched by being devoured by a creature with a Magic Might of at least 5.
related: Realms of Power: Magic p.122 Dedicated vis

title: New Creo Herbam guidelines (healing plants)
heading: New Creo Herbam Guidelines
summary: Adds Creo Herbam guidelines for healing wounds, disease and poison in plants, and notes that non-Momentary healing spells suspend rather than complete healing, as for Creo Corpus.
quotes: Like Creo Corpus healing spells, a healing spell cast other than as a Momentary Duration Ritual actually suspends the healing process
related: ArM5 Creo Corpus healing guidelines

title: The Wolf's Court aura and the She-Wolf's manifestation
heading: The Court
summary: Gives the Magic aura of the Wolf's Court and describes how the She-Wolf forms a body, assesses petitioners without negotiation and speaks with her Voice of the Wolf power.
quotes: The Wolf's Court itself is situated in a Magic aura of 5.

title: Aspects of a Daimon (the She-Wolf)
heading: Inhabitants
requires: Being type: Aspect of a Daimon
summary: Explains how a spirit that creates a material body behaves: it can dismiss and recreate its body, the Daimon can send a new Aspect after a day, Acclimation applies, and spending Might on Virtues and Flaws erodes the Aspect. Also advises how to use such a spirit as a provider of vengeance rather than an antagonist.
quotes: If the Aspect is destroyed, the spirit can send another to the Wolf's Court after a day has passed.
related: Realms of Power: Magic p.102 Daimon
Realms of Power: Magic p.52 Acclimation
Realms of Power: Magic p.46 Master of Animal Creatures

title: How the She-Wolf grants revenge
heading: How the She-Wolf Grants Revenge
requires: Being type: Aspect of a Daimon
summary: Describes how a spirit judges a petitioner's claim and then bestows Virtues or Flaws through its powers, either permanently (costing Might score as well as pool) or temporarily (Might not recovered while the effect lasts).
quotes: If permanent, the power is a ritual-like power and costs points from the creature's Might score as well as Might pool.
If temporary, the power lasts until the She-Wolf dismisses it, but the Might points spent on this power are not recovered while it is ongoing.

title: Ritual of passing on the power
heading: The Ritual of Passing on the Power
summary: The optional ritual by which the She-Wolf endows a petitioner, which also gives the spirit an Arcane Connection and sympathetic connections to the recipient.
quotes: This ritual is not strictly necessary, but it provides an appropriate amount of mystery and formality to the seeking of vengeance.

title: Spiritual Pact (Major Supernatural Virtue)
heading: New Virtue: Spiritual Pact
summary: Extended rules for a character bound by pact to a Magic spirit: spending a Confidence Point to draw a temporary Might pool, how Penetration and duration work, the lack of a Might score, and how the spirit's own pool is reduced.
quotes: Make a Presence + Magic Lore + stress die roll: this is the amount of Magic Might Pool that the character acquires from his spiritual master.
A character can only have a single pact.
related: Realms of Power: Magic pp.88-89

title: The Wolf Brothers (Luperci cult overview)
heading: The Wolf Brothers
summary: Introduces the Luperci as a non-Hermetic Mystery Cult whose members use the Wolf's Court for Initiations, with the She-Wolf as magical patron; the storyguide chooses how widespread it is.
quotes: This priesthood still exists as a Mystery Cult

title: The Luperci Mystery Cult: grades and Initiations
heading: The Luperci
summary: Describes the three grades of the Luperci cult, the Organization Lore: Luperci needed for each, the Virtues and Flaws gained at each Initiation and their Initiation Script bonuses and Ease Factors, and the lykaia rite for magistri.
quotes: The most junior grade is called the *lupellis*, which requires an Organization Lore: Luperci of at least 1.
(Initiation Script +9 for the Major Flaw; Ease Factor 15)
a character must have an Organization Lore: Luperci of 5 before being considered for this rank
related: The Mysteries Revised Edition Chapter Two
Realms of Power: Magic p.45 Lesser Power

title: The Luperci as a Hermetic Mystery Cult (variant)
heading: The Luperci as a Hermetic Mystery Cult
requires: Optional variant: Hermetic version of the Luperci
summary: Optional variant making the Luperci a Hermetic cult open only to magi, adjusting the crimes it avenges and the meaning of its Dark Secret, and noting that Gifted characters need not take an Ordeal at every Initiation.
quotes: Unlike unGifted characters, Gifted individuals do not have to take an Ordeal at every Initiation
related: Hedge Magic Revised Edition p.14

title: The Lupercalia curse-breaking rite
heading: THE LUPERCALIA
summary: Yearly festival during which the senior Luperci present may attempt to dispel a curse on the community with a Communication roll against the curse's level, with bonuses for individuals brought to justice.
quotes: To evoke this power requires a Communication + Organization Lore: Luperci + stress die against an Ease Factor equal to the level of the spell that generated the curse (or 5 x the Supernatural Ability used to lay it).
it receives a bonus of +3 for every individual who has been brought to justice in the last year

title: Wolf pack hunt: overview of the five phases
heading: Hunted by Colves
summary: Introduces the structured procedure a storyguide uses when a wolf pack hunts the characters: stalk, encounter, rush, chase and kill.
quotes: A wolf hunt has five main phases: the stalk, the encounter, the rush, the chase, and the kill.

title: Pack hunt: the stalk
heading: The Stalk
summary: Tracking rolls to find and follow a trail, and the stealth-versus-awareness roll that determines how close a stalking pack creeps before the prey is alerted or spooked.
quotes: A Perception + Awareness roll is needed to find tracks, and a Perception + Hunt roll is needed to follow them.
The wolf pack should make a Dexterity + Stealth roll; the Ease Factor is the Perception + Awareness roll of the prey.
Each success made by the pursuers allows them to creep (10+Qik) paces closer to their prey.

title: Pack hunt: the encounter
heading: The Encounter
summary: The point at which prey and predators confront each other: prey that holds its ground leads to the kill, prey that flees leads to the rush, and wolves try to isolate individuals from a group.
quotes: During the encounter wolves attempt to break up groups of prey, preferably isolating one or two from the rest.

title: Pack hunt: the rush (short pursuit rules)
heading: The Rush
summary: Round-by-round pursuit rules for a short sprint: opposed Quickness and Athletics rolls open or close the distance, running speeds differ for four-legged and two-legged creatures, and each round also risks a Fatigue level.
quotes: Rush Total: Quickness + Athletics – Encumbrance + stress die
Change of distance for winner (four legs): (10 + Quickness – Encumbrance) paces
Rush Fatigue roll: Stamina + Athletics – Encumbrance + stress die against Ease Factor 9
related: Lords of Men p.120 running speeds

title: Pack hunt: the chase (long pursuit rules)
heading: The Chase
summary: Long-distance pursuit rules: each round both sides test endurance for Long Term Fatigue, then compare a Pursuit Total against an Evasion Total, with modifiers for leg count and knowledge of the terrain, until one side wins enough rounds.
quotes: Chase Fatigue roll: Stamina + Athletics – Encumbrance roll against Ease Factor 12
Pursuit Total: Perception + Hunt – Fatigue penalty + Pursuit modifiers + stress die
Dexterity + Athletics – Fatigue penalty + Evasion modifiers + stress die

title: Pack hunt: the kill (trained group and trip attacks)
heading: The Kill
summary: How an attacking pack fights: a trained group led by the pack leader, swapping group members with a Leadership roll, and trip maneuvers that leave a target with a reduced Defense.
quotes: making a roll of Communication + Leadership + stress die against an Ease Factor of 9
If the Attack Total exceeds the Defense Total by three or more, then the target is tripped
related: ArM5 p.175 trip maneuver
Lords of Men p.125 Evasion
